title: Automatic sprinkler locations.
officialText:
Sprinkler systems shall be installed at 12-foot (3658 mm) intervals in horizontal
ducts and at changes in direction. In vertical ducts, sprinklers shall be installed at the top and at alternate floor levels.
SECTION BC 416
APPLICATION OF FLAMMABLE FINISHES
